title: ProductionCard
description: A per-chapter PRODUCTION CARD (roadmap 4.6, Publishing OS). It is the single read-side summary a human consults when deciding whether to PUBLISH one chapter: it folds together every signal the pipeline already produced for that chapter — its lifecycle status (drafted/reviewed/published), its quality-report v2 scores, its commercial-loop movement, its pacing, and — the anchor — its publish-readiness recommendation. It introduces no new judgment: every field is a deterministic read of an existing artifact, so the same chapter always yields the same card. Written to registry/derived/production-card/, NEVER to registry/facts/ (a card is not a story fact, ADR-006). Two structural invariants: `gating` const false — a card NEVER blocks a build (ADR-003); `authority` const human — the publish decision the card informs is an outward, irreversible transition only a human executes (ADR-009). The card CITES the publish-readiness verdict; it does not recompute or override it.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the publish decision this card informs is executed only by a human.

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): a production card NEVER blocks a build; it is advisory read-side aggregation.

status.description: Lifecycle stage from the inventory funnel (P19): the highest stage this chapter has reached. 'published' comes only from the authored log (ADR-009).

publish_readiness.description: The CITED publish-readiness verdict (Phase 4.1) — the anchor of the card. Lifted from the draft envelope's publish_readiness, not recomputed. Absent envelope degrades to recommendation='unknown'.

quality.description: The chapter's quality-report v2 commercial signals, lifted from its qa_review envelope. Advisory; absent when the chapter carries no quality report.

commercial.description: The commercial-loop movement for this chapter (Phase 4.4), lifted from its commercial_session envelope. Comparison-only movement, never an absolute score.

pacing.description: The chapter's intra-chapter pacing readout (P22), recomputed from its persisted scene plan when present.

flags.description: Deterministic attention flags synthesized from the above (e.g. 'publish-blocked', 'publish-hold', 'high-drop-risk', 'pay-leak', 'pacing-warning'). A human reads these to triage; they never gate.

rationale.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the card.
